config.restoreSessions: Reopen grid terminals after a window reload, in the same folders and with their last screen.
config.shell: Shell for grid terminals. Empty uses the editor's default shell.
config.shellArgs: Shell arguments. `null` starts a login shell on macOS, like Terminal.app.
view.name: Terminal Grid
command.toggle: Show Grid or Go Back to the Editor
config.focusLayout: When the grid opens in the bottom panel, maximize it and keep only the Explorer next to it. Opening a file brings the usual layout back.
config.newTerminalShortcut: Ctrl+Shift+\` opens a new terminal in the grid instead of the Terminal tab.
config.mirrorTerminals: Show terminals that were opened outside the grid (in the Terminal tab or by other extensions) as tiles. Needs `enable-proposed-api` for this extension in the editor's argv.json.
config.shiftEnterSequence: What Shift+Enter sends in grid terminals. The default, ESC followed by Enter (the same as Alt+Enter), is what many command line programs read as a new line instead of sending the input. Empty sends a plain Enter.
